svg.title: Atlantic Equatorial Undercurrent: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 4500 km. Declared Atlantic equatorial subsurface-jet reach from the 35 W observational section to an OSW 5 E pre-island approach gate. Excludes western North Brazil retroflection source paths, island bifurcation near 6 E, downstream branches and westward returns. Not full source-to-termination length or an observed material trajectory. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate 35 W to pre-island equatorial reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Napolitano et al. (2022); Hormann & Brandt (2007); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
